title: Effect of hardware noise
description: Mean over 1 fixed-seed 10-asset, K=5, q=0.5 instances (no sector cap or target, zero costs), est window 2023-10-01..2025-09-30. XY mixer + Dicke, p = 2, COBYLA, ramp init; the same optimised parameters sampled ideally and under noise.
notes: FakeGuadalupeV2 noise model, sample-only (parameters optimised noiselessly)
Best mixer from the depth study at p = 2 (lowest 1 - r): XY mixer + Dicke.
Synthetic subset of NIFTY 50 tickers; estimation window 2023-10-01..2025-09-30
1 instance(s) with seeds [1], QAOA seed = instance seed, maxiter 60, 4096 shots; yerr is the sample standard deviation over instances.
